build_convnext_isotropic_small: build a ConvNeXt isotropic small model with 18 depth and 384 feature dimensions
build_convnext_isotropic_base: build a ConvNeXt isotropic base model with 18 depth and 768 feature dimensions
build_convnext_isotropic_large: build a ConvNeXt isotropic large model with 36 depth and 1024 feature dimensions
run_forward_features: run forward_features on the ConvNeXtIsotropic model to extract features with global average pooling
load_pretrained_convnext_isotropic: load a pretrained ConvNeXt isotropic model from a FAIR URL checkpoint
